summary_en: SE Holdings and Incubations authorized acquisition of up to 400,000 shares (2.68% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 160 million yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 23 to December 18, 2026, to enable flexible management in response to changing economic conditions.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Treasury Stock Acquisition
translation_en_brief:
SE Holdings and Incubations authorized a share buyback program at a meeting of the Board of Directors on October 22, 2026. The company will acquire up to 400,000 shares of its common stock, representing 2.68% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum aggregate consideration of 160 million yen. The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from October 23, 2026, to December 18, 2026.

The company stated that the purpose of the buyback is to enable flexible management in response to changes in economic conditions. At the date of the announcement, the company held 1,353,409 treasury shares, with 14,930,817 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
